author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: the ant's middle legs now sit higher (leaving the thorax at y22, was 28) and curve upward, and the lower legs curve downward from the abdomen's sides; head, thorax, abdomen and antennae as before, mirrored about x = 24.
omissions: The middle legs leave the thorax at the single point exactly 8 from both the head and the abdomen, so head and abdomen are slightly smaller (r5 and r7).
drawing_plan: VRECT_L: head r5 (24,9); thorax (24,14)-(24,30) split at (24,22); abdomen r7 (24,37); middle-leg cubics (24,22)->(8,14)/(40,14); lower-leg cubics from (17,37)/(31,37) to (8,44)/(40,44); antennae (20,6)-(17,4)-(10,4) and mirror.
